Job Description: AI Engineer (GenAI / Agentic AI)

About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer with strong expertise in Generative AI and Agentic AI, combined with solid production engineering capabilities.




The ideal candidate will need to have hands-on experience building, deploying, and scaling LLM-powered systems moving beyond prototypes into robust, enterprise-grade AI applications.

Key Responsibilities:

Design, build, and deploy GenAI / Agentic AI solutions, including:
LLM pipelines
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems o Autonomous AI agents
Develop scalable APIs, microservices, and model-serving architectures using cloud platforms (Azure preferred).
Implement:
Prompt engineering and prompt workflows o Embeddings and vector search
Guardrails and safety mechanisms for responsible AI
Deploy production AI systems using:
Docker, Kubernetes o CI/CD pipelines
Monitoring and observability frameworks
Integrate AI solutions with enterprise systems, data sources, and external APIs.
Ensure reliability, performance, compliance, and alignment with Responsible AI standards.

Must-Have Skills (GenAI / Agentic AI):

Hands-on experience in Generative AI development using models such as: o GPT, Claude, Llama, Mistral, etc.
Strong experience in Agentic AI, including:
Multi-step AI agents o Tool-calling workflows o Autonomous task pipelines
Expertise in RAG architectures and vector databases such as:
Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Azure Cognitive Search
Proficiency in Python or JavaScript/TypeScript.
Experience with frameworks like: o Azure OpenAI, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar
Strong production engineering skills:
Docker, Kubernetes o CI/CD pipelines
API development and deployment best practices

Nice to Have:

Model fine-tuning, quantization, or optimization experience.
Familiarity with LLM evaluation frameworks such as: o Ragas, TruLens, DeepEval
Exposure to event-driven or real-time AI systems.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

4+ years of experience with GCP, including 2+ years hands-on with Vertex AI

Experience building Vertex AI Pipelines and managing model lifecycle in Vertex AI Model Registry
Solid Terraform skills for provisioning Vertex AI, GCS, BigQuery, and associated infrastructure

About the Role:

This position is with a Japan-based management consulting firm in Bangalore, driving Digital Transformation (DX) for Japanese enterprises. Hiring is managed by INDIGILAB as a recruitment partner. Full details will be shared with shortlisted candidates.




We are looking for a Tech Lead who bridges deep SaaS/backend engineering with AI agent development acting as the technical and cultural bridge between Japan HQ and the India GCC. Japanese language skills or experience working with Japanese enterprises is a strong advantage.




Key Responsibilities:

Design and build production AI agent workflows, RAG pipelines, and LLM-powered automation
Coordinate with Japan HQ to translate business challenges into AI and SaaS system requirements
Build backend services and APIs integrating with business systems (Zoho, GCP, etc.)
Own reliability patterns: retries, idempotency, structured logging, and monitoring
Lead design reviews, code reviews, and mentor a team of 3-5 engineers



Must-Have Skills & Experience:

10+ years of total engineering experience (SaaS/backend)
8+ years hands-on with Python, Node.js, or Java
5+ years with a frontend framework (React / Vue / Angular)
3+ years of production AI/LLM experience shipped real product using Gemini, Claude, or OpenAI
Production experience on GCP or AWS
Practical RAG knowledge and team leadership experience (35 engineers)



Preferred Skills

Japanese communication ability at JLPT N2 or equivalent strong advantage for direct collaboration with Japan HQ
Experience working in or closely with a Japanese corporate environment
Experience building or integrating MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers
Experience integrating with Zoho CRM, Creator, or Books via REST APIs



Why Join:

Work with Japan
Act as the technical bridge between India and Japan HQ. Gain direct exposure to Japanese business culture and enterprise-level DX projects.




Lead AI at the Frontier Own the architecture of production-grade AI agents, RAG systems, and LLM-powered workflows not PoC, but real systems in production.




Ownership & Impact
Lead a team of engineers and drive end-to-end delivery of AI-powered digital transformation projects for Japanese enterprises.




Growth
Work at the intersection of AI engineering, SaaS integration, and cross-cultural consulting in a fast-moving environment.

Generative AI/LLM Engineer | Careers | Soothsayer Analytics Apply to job Generative AI/LLM Engineer About the Role:

We are seeking a talented Generative AI/LLM Engineer with a strong background in building and deploying AI models, focusing on leveraging state-of-the-art technologies like Azure OpenAI GPT-4, GPT-4 Vision, or GPT-4 Omni. Experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and working with Vector Databases is essential. While fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) is a plus, it is not mandatory. A general understanding of how deep learning models are trained or fine-tuned is required. The ideal candidate should be able to quickly learn and implement advanced techniques, even if they do not initially possess all the required experience.

Key Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and deploy generative AI models using GPT-4 variants, including GPT-4 Vision and GPT-4 Turbo, tailored to address specific business needs.

Implement and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques for enhanced data-driven solutions.

Build and manage AI services using Python frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex, and develop APIs with FastAPI or Quart for efficient integration.

Focus on scalability, performance, and optimization of AI solutions across cloud environments, particularly with Azure and AWS.

Work with Vector Databases (mandatory) and optionally Graph Databases for enhanced data management.

Utilize Cosmos DB and SQL for robust data storage and management solutions.

Apply MLOps or LLMOps practices to automate and streamline the AI model lifecycle, including CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and maintenance.

Implement and manage Azure Pipelines for continuous integration and deployment.

Continuously research and adopt the latest advancements in AI, with a focus on quick learning and implementation of emerging technologies.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

Bachelor s or Master s degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or a related field.

A minimum of 1+ years of experience specifically in Generative AI/LLM technologies, and 5+ years of experience in related fields.

Proficiency in Python and experience with frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, FastAPI, or Quart.

Expertise in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and experience with Vector Databases (mandatory).

Experience with Cosmos DB and SQL.

Fine-tuning LLMs and experience with Graph Databases are good to have but not mandatory.

Proven experience in MLOps, LLMOps, or DevOps with a strong understanding of CI/CD processes, automation, and pipeline management.

Familiarity with containers, Docker, or Kubernetes is a plus.

Familiarity with cloud platforms, particularly Azure or AWS, and experience with cloud-native AI services.

Strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive approach to learning new AI trends and best practices quickly.
